description: Create or update up to 100 Zendesk users in a single request; new users require a name. Returns a background job status, with per-user results when available.

inputSchema.description: Request model for creating or updating multiple users.

users.description: Array of user objects to create or update. Up to 100 users can be included. For new users, 'name' is required. For existing users, 'id' is required to identify the user to update.
users.human_parameter_description: Array of user objects (up to 100). Each user needs 'name' for new users or 'id' for existing users.

items.description: Individual user object for create_or_update_many operation.

locale.human_parameter_description: Locale tag for the user (e.g., en-US).
locale.title: Locale

remote_photo_url.human_parameter_description: URL for the user's profile photo.
remote_photo_url.title: Remote Photo Url

group_ids.description: Array of group IDs to add the user to
group_ids.human_parameter_description: List of group IDs to assign the user to.
group_ids.title: Group Ids

external_id.description: External system ID for the user (case-insensitive)
external_id.human_parameter_description: Unique identifier from an external system.
external_id.title: External Id

agent_brand_ids.description: Array of brand IDs for an agent
agent_brand_ids.human_parameter_description: Brand IDs to associate with an agent.
agent_brand_ids.title: Agent Brand Ids

only_private_comments.description: Whether the user can only leave private comments
only_private_comments.human_parameter_description: Set to true to restrict to private comments only.
only_private_comments.title: Only Private Comments

tags.description: Array of tags for the user
tags.human_parameter_description: Tags to assign to the user.
tags.title: Tags

phone.description: Phone number of the user in E.164 format
phone.title: Phone

name.description: Full name of the user. Required for new users. Optional for updates (if id is provided).
name.human_parameter_description: Full name of the user to create or update.
name.title: Name

organization.description: Organization object for the user (string key-value pairs)
organization.title: Organization

email.description: Primary email address of the user
email.title: Email

alias.human_parameter_description: Optional alias shown to end users.
alias.title: Alias

custom_role_id.description: Agent-only: ID of a custom agent role
custom_role_id.human_parameter_description: Custom agent role ID when role is 'agent'.
custom_role_id.title: Custom Role Id

skip_verify_email.description: If true, skip sending verification email to new users
skip_verify_email.human_parameter_description: Set to true to skip email verification.
skip_verify_email.title: Skip Verify Email

moderator.description: Whether the user is a moderator
moderator.human_parameter_description: Set to true to make the user a moderator.
moderator.title: Moderator

role.description: User role. Defaults to 'end-user' if not specified.
role.human_parameter_description: Role for the user: end-user, agent, or admin.
role.title: Role

organization_ids.description: Array of organization IDs the user belongs to
organization_ids.title: Organization Ids

verified.description: Whether the user's email has been verified
verified.human_parameter_description: Set to true if the user's email is verified.
verified.title: Verified

identities.description: Array of user identities (type and value as strings)
identities.title: Identities

active_brand_id.description: Brand ID of the user's active brand
active_brand_id.human_parameter_description: Active brand ID for the user.
active_brand_id.title: Active Brand Id

suspended.human_parameter_description: Set to true to suspend the user.
suspended.title: Suspended

user_fields.description: Key-value map of custom user fields (values must be strings)
user_fields.human_parameter_description: Custom user field values (string key-value pairs).
user_fields.title: User Fields

active.description: Whether the user is active. Defaults to true if not specified.
active.human_parameter_description: Set to false to deactivate the user.
active.title: Active

id.description: User ID for updating an existing user. If provided, the user with this ID will be updated. If not provided, a new user will be created.
id.human_parameter_description: Numeric ID of an existing Zendesk user to update. Omit to create a new user.
id.title: Id

shared_phone_number.description: Whether the user shares a phone number with other users
shared_phone_number.human_parameter_description: Set to true if the phone number is shared.
shared_phone_number.title: Shared Phone Number

organization_name.description: Name of an organization to add the user to. Creates the organization if it doesn't exist.
organization_name.human_parameter_description: Name of organization to create or add user to.
organization_name.title: Organization Name

default_group_id.description: ID of the user's default group
default_group_id.human_parameter_description: Numeric ID of the default group.
default_group_id.title: Default Group Id

organization_id.description: ID of the user's default organization
organization_id.human_parameter_description: Numeric ID of the default organization.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

items.title: UserCreateOrUpdateItem

users.title: Users
